'''Mariko Kouda''' (Japanese: '''國府田マリ子''' ''Kouda Mariko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kouda was born on September 5, 1989, in {{wp|Miyashiro, Saitama}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She graduated from Kasukabe Kyōei High School and became a communications major at Tamagawa University in {{wp|Machida, Tokyo}}. After graduating from college in 1990, Kouda became a voice actress, singer, and radio personality as an adult. She was once affiliated with the {{wp|J-pop}} voice acting group Drops, which has since disbanded. Kouda became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|GS}}, voicing recurring character [[Sakura]], a [[Kimono Girl]]. She is currently affiliated with the talent management firm {{wp|Aoni Production}}. She announced her marriage in 2003.
